subject: Delivering CI snapshot + change-history for SDLC evidence
messages:
From: Claire Morris <security@findata.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Vega <alex.vega@findata.com>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: CI artifacts + change history for SIG assessment

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our ongoing SIG intake we've requested a compact evidence bundle focused on Secure SDLC controls: code review policy adherence, CI/CD control snapshots, secrets handling (ephemeral credentials / vault access), and the last 6 months of change approvals and rollback capability.

Can you provide:
- a CI run snapshot that includes pipeline job names, timestamps, and logs (redacted where necessary) for a representative deploy from May 10 2028;
- a CSV export of change approvals/change IDs covering Nov 2027 — May 2028;
- confirmation of KMS/HSM rotation cadence and a short log of the last rotation event;
- your rollback playbook or incident runbook that shows how you authorize and perform emergency rollbacks.

We prefer a Drive link or zipped artifacts. If anything is sensitive, a stub and description is fine (we'll coordinate an NDA-backed transfer). Our assessor team (cc'ed) will triage.

Target timeline: can you get a first-pass bundle by EOD Monday (May 13)? Even partial delivery helps.

Appreciate it —
Claire
Claire Morris
Lead, Security Assessments
FinData Solutions

---
(Please don't include full private keys in attachments; redaction is expected.)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Morris <security@findata.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: CI artifacts + change history for SIG assessment

Claire —

Thanks for the clear list. Looping in Dylan (Platform Reliability / CI) and Monica (Security & Compliance) to assemble the package. High-level notes below and we'll follow up with the Drive link and attachments.

Quick answers:
- CI snapshot: we'll include the full pipeline JSON for the May 10 deploy (job names, timestamps, job outputs). PII/service tokens redacted; we will include the commit SHAs and build artifact checksums.
- Change history: CSV export from our change-approval service with approver, timestamp, ticket id, and approval type (manual/canary/auto).
- KMS rotation: quarterly rotations; last rotation executed 2028-03-28 (rotation metadata + certificate thumbprints included).
- Rollback playbook: we'll attach v2.1 of the rollback playbook; it includes authorization flow, gating, and post-rollback verification steps.

We expect to have the first bundle available by Mon 2028-05-13 EOD PST. If you need anything sooner (e.g., a quick sample of logs) tell us which jobs and we'll extract.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Trust & Controls
Redwood Inference

Subject: CI snapshot + change export ready (attached stubs)

Claire / Evelyn / Monica —

I've attached the artifacts we can send via Drive today. Attachments include:
- redwood-ci-run-2028-05-10.json (CI run JSON, logs truncated, tokens redacted)
- change-history-2027-11-to-2028-05.csv (export from change-approval service)
- kms-rotation-log-2028-Q1.pdf (rotation summary, no private key material)
- rollback-playbook-v2.1.md (internal runbook)

Notes / highlights:
- The CI JSON includes a consecutive job trace for a blue/green deploy to dedicated-gpu-prod, showing the canary gate checks (latency/health) and automated promotion. Where we truncate logs we include byte offsets and a checksum so you can verify non-modified excerpts if needed.
- Secrets handling: ephemeral tokens for runners are issued from our ephemeral vault with TTLs of 15 minutes; we included an example token issuance event (redacted) and the Vault policy ID.
- Change approvals: CSV maps each PR/MR to a change ticket and lists the approver (team lead) and the authorization channel (manual approval, auto-canary, or scheduled).
- Rollback auth: playbook requires two approvers from the platform SRE leadership group; there's an emergency bypass scope granted to the on-call lead with post-facto ticketing.

Drive link (read-only): https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/FinData/SIG-evidence/ci-snapshots/2028-05-10
We can provide a signed hash of each attachment if your assessor needs tamper-evidence.

Questions welcome.
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Platform Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: redwood-ci-run-2028-05-10.json (truncated), change-history-2027-11-to-2028-05.csv (full), kms-rotation-log-2028-Q1.pdf (summary), rollback-playbook-v2.1.md

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Morris <security@findata.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 May 2028 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CI snapshot + change export ready (attached stubs)

Claire —

Following up to confirm delivery and to answer a couple assessor questions we often see:

1) Evidence of code review enforcement: our CI pipeline rejects merges unless the required approvers check has passed. The exported CSV includes a "review_passed" flag and the GitHub PR id. For auditor sampling we can produce the PR diff view with reviewer timestamps (redacted emails).

2) Secret scanning and PR gating: we run a secret-scan job during PR validation (results stored for 90 days). Any scan finding creates a blocking ticket in our backlog; the CI snapshot includes a sample finding id (masked) and the ticket reference.

3) Emergency rollback test: we run quarterly tabletop and a staged rollback drill; the most recent drill occurred 2028-04-12 and a short after-action summary is in the Drive folder.

If you need the raw logs rather than truncated versions we'll coordinate an encrypted transfer. Otherwise please confirm the artifacts suffice for the SIG assessor and we will update the DocuSign NDA envelope if needed.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
